comment: feat(libstylist): directory namespaces — package.json `libstylist.namespaces` maps package-relative directories to a namespace of their own (`"src/render": "render"`, or `{ namespace, segment?, word? }`); a file takes the longest directory containing it, so an app's `RenderInvitationRow` in src/render is `<crm-render-invitationrow>`. `resolvePackageConfig` returns the file's effective config (plus its base config and directory) through a cached package finder (`findLibstylistPackage`) and a per-file pick (`packageConfigOf`); the transform, the lint rules (tag-name, rootLocals, segment discovery), gen-types and the checker follow it
